headline: I searched my heart for what you asked me to feel. It understood the request, but returned 404 NOT FOUND.
caption:
I searched my heart for what you asked me to feel. It understood the request, but returned 404 NOT FOUND.

—
404 NOT FOUND: the server understood the request but the thing does not exist.
